ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to 55% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black region centered at the peduncle insertion and extending vertically to the median notch. High-intensity light grey contiguous zones occupy the majority of both lateral lobes. A distinct dark, low-intensity geometric blob is localized on the proximal leading edge of the left lobe. Vertical low-intensity streaks are localized on the distal half of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 105 degrees; depth extends approximately 18% into the fluke's vertical bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel variations along the entire trailing boundary. The left lobe trailing edge exhibits deep, sharp-angled serrations (amplitude 5-15 pixels). The right lobe trailing edge presents a lower-frequency, more rounded serration profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges following a parabolic curve toward the tips. Trailing edges exhibit a negative concave sweep from the tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A cluster of approximately 6-10 high-intensity white punctate spots localized within the central black pigmentation of the peduncle area. Scattered low-intensity dark circular mottling observed on the medial high-intensity zone of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, sub-parallel vertical dark linear disruptions (rake marks) on the distal region of the right lobe. One horizontal dark linear disruption on the proximal region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch and missing tissue segment at the terminal tip of the left lobe. Significant jagged mechanical wear observed on the distal trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark filamentous pixel clusters (likely bio-fouling/algae) adhering to the outer extremities and trailing edges of both lobes.
